关键词: five consecutive years of sales increases
fuel efficient all wheel drive car
主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. announced it has sold its six millionth vehicle in the United States. The 2013 XV Crosstrek was sold at Subaru of Georgetown in Georgetown, Texas. Thomas J. Doll, executive vice president and COO, stated that the company reached this milestone faster than before, taking 16 years to reach the first million but expecting to hit the next million in under three years. Subaru of America is the only automaker with five consecutive years of sales increases during 2008-2012 and has broken its annual sales records for the past four years. Doll highlighted the company's long-standing relationship with American buyers and noted that 96% of Subaru vehicles built in the last ten years are still on the road today, reflecting their longevity.
